d: This position is responsible for managing all local computer technology and services in the Hotel which can include, but is not limited to: networks, hardware, operating systems, anti-virus, internet access and all related systems, office automation and email systems, departmental systems for front office, back office, sales & catering, personnel, spa, and other network based software supporting these systems; network security and compliance; where not the responsibility of the Engineering department, cabling, access control system, voice and guest technologies..
r: li
First point of contact for all computer related issues within the hotel.
li
Solve technical or operational problems as reported by the users.
li
Ensure that equipment is in proper working order and application performance is optimized
li
Ensure that all 24/7 systems (i.e. front office, point of sale, email and internet) are monitored and that technical service is available any time.
li
Ensure that backups are performed and checked on a regular basis.
li
Ensure that hotel network, systems and data is secured from unwanted intrusion and in line with stated Kempinski standards and rules and regulations given by law.
li
Ensure that IT contingency systems for all key business areas are in proper working order and that staff are trained in the switching to, and use of, these contingency systems.
li
Follow Kempinski policies as they relate to the security and operation of the computer systems.
li
Ensure that the IT organizational requirements for legal, data protection and PCI compliance are in place.
li
Update all computer systems with the latest security patches to minimize internal and external access security risks.
li
Train and maintain back-up staff for each server-based application
li
Ensure first level support backup is in place for all systems and network.
li
In cooperation with all other department heads; design and implement new computer based procedures that will improve profitability, operations and work efficiencies.
li
Coordinate the installation of all new applications or upgrades of existing applications.
li
Coordinate and review all new software development specific to the hotel, in accordance to Kempinski policies and standards.
li
Implement all corporate IT related policies and procedures and carry out an annual self audit.
li
Provide advice to better expedite access and to improve the use of information in the Hotel.
li
Take direction from the Corporate IT department as it relates to the technical operation of computer technology hardware and software.
li
Communicate status, risks and opportunities as it relates to IT to Corporate & Regional IT, General Manager and Hotel Management.
li
Responsible for communication with computer vendors and Kempinski Corporate IT Department.
li
Responsible for timely preparation and submission of all IT budgets
li
Responsible for the management and control of all IT budgets according to an agreed plan and budget.
li
Ensure a business continuity plan is established and tested together with the department heads for all part of the business supported by IT.
li
Maximize employee productivity and morale within the department and consistently maintain discipline within hotel guidelines and local regulations.
li
Schedule employees in line with varying business levels in order to maximize productivity and minimize payroll costs.
li
Select and recruit suitable employees for the department using prescribed set of policies and procedures.
li
Identifie employees with potential for promotion and/or transfer and makes appropriate development plans for him/her together Director of People Services.
li
Work within all pre-set budgetary limits.
p
Additional responsibilities and tasks can be added at any time according to the needs of the business and of the hotel.

d: Company Description Kuwait Credit Information Network Company (CINET) is a closed Kuwaiti shareholding company specializing in the collection, preservation, analysis, and use of credit information to prepare credit records and issue credit reports and ratings for individual and corporate clients. The company develops risk tools, standards, and related data in line with Law No. 9 of 2019 on the regulation of credit information exchange and its executive regulations. CINET serves financial, banking, and commercial sectors with a broad range of services in credit reporting, credit rating, and value-added solutions. The organization focuses on data integrity, regulatory compliance, and innovation to support informed lending and risk management decisions. Professionals joining CINET can contribute to shaping credit information standards within Kuwait’s evolving financial landscape.
To be responsible for ensuring the smooth and secure operation of the network, supporting users' connectivity needs, and maintaining network hardware, software, and related systems.
q: Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
Possession of relevant professional certificates is preferred such (e.g. PMP, ITIL, CISSP, CISA, CRISC)
Minimum 4 to 6 years of experience in Network Administration for the financial sector
r: li
Network Operations & Availability: Oversee, monitor, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure to ensure high availability, reliability, performance, and 24/7 operational continuity.
li
Infrastructure Management: Manage network hardware, software, and related infrastructure, including configuration, maintenance, upgrades, troubleshooting, and capacity planning.
li
Incident & Problem Management: Investigate and resolve network incidents, perform root cause analysis, coordinate corrective actions, and provide on-call support for critical issues.
li

Network Security & Compliance: Maintain network security controls, identify infrastructure risks, and ensure adherence to organizational policies, security standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
li
Change & Configuration Management: Coordinate infrastructure changes, maintain accurate configuration records within the CMDB, and ensure compliance with established change management procedures.
li

Infrastructure Planning & Optimization: Assess current network capabilities, identify performance bottlenecks, and recommend improvements to support business growth and evolving technology requirements.
li

Operational Monitoring & Reporting: Track network performance, availability, incidents, and operational effectiveness, providing regular reports, trend analysis, and recommendations for continuous improvement.
li

Business & Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external subscribers to assess connectivity requirements, design appropriate network solutions, communicate service changes, and address operational concerns.
li
Operational Procedures & Documentation: Develop, review, and maintain network operating procedures, technical documentation, maintenance records, and operational standards.
li
Regulatory & Specialized Operations: Support regulatory reporting and operational processes, including subscriber IFF submissions, while ensuring compliance with applicable CBK and MOCI requirements.
